jamie: Trying to promote v2026.03.1 canary and deploy-bot is failing with artifact checksum mismatch, blocking the promotion.
deploy-bot: promotion attempt for v2026.03.1 -> FAILED
jamie: Error shows runner restored a stale snapshot index which doesn't line up with the artifact manifest index. suspect ephemeral runner snapshot rotation during high load.
ci-bot: build job #4823: ERROR: artifact checksum mismatch for redis-image.tar.gz (expected a1b2.. got c3d4..)
mike: @jamie drop the minimal log and which runner pool?
jamie: pool=ephemeral-linux-xlarge
jamie: ```
Restoring snapshot: s3://ci-snapshots/ephemeral-linux-xlarge/2026-03-20T12:03:00.tar.gz
Applied snapshot metadata: index=1248 ttl=300
Fetching artifact manifest: index=1251
ERROR: manifest index mismatch: snapshot_index(1248) != manifest_index(1251)
Checksum validation failed for redis-image.tar.gz
```
olivia: we've hit this before — snapshot rotation can delete the newest prefix between list and get, so a runner may pick an older snapshot if rotation happens mid-select. atomic apply doesn't help that race.
sre-oncall: is this something we can patch quickly or do we need a rollback to v2026.03.0 to meet the release window? marketing has an announcement in ~45m.
jamie: CI gating requires green build for promotion. we can't push the canary until CI passes.
mike: short options: 1) revert promotion to v2026.03.0 to keep schedule 2) reupload correct snapshot + bump TTL then rerun CI 3) force rebuild with --no-cache (but may still pull old snapshot if index mismatch persists)
anna: preference? what's fastest to get green while minimizing churn?
jamie: I can do manual snapshot reupload and increase TTL; estimate ~20m.
sre-oncall: that sounds reasonable. we'll avoid a rollback unless the 20m path fails. also add a runtime guard to verify manifest index after download.
olivia: opening ISSUE-789: "ephemeral runner snapshot selection race" and assigning to infra. will include a small safety-net fix and a TODO for TTL autoscaling under load.
ci-bot: note: rerunning job without addressing snapshot index may produce same mismatch.
mike: proposed immediate steps (manual):
- bump snapshot TTL to 900 for ephemeral-linux-xlarge
- reupload snapshot with manifest index=1251 to expected s3 path
- restart CI job #4823 with `--no-cache` to force rebuild and avoid cached artifacts
